title: Residency Pin Operator: SLA-tier pinning, per-route overrides, and evidence snapshots
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Background: Enterprise customers require deterministic residency behavior for hosted API calls combined with auditable evidence that the tenant's requests remained in approved regions. Current residency controls allow tenant-level region preferences but lack: (1) SLA-tier aware pinning (e.g., guaranteed region for P1 customers), (2) per-route residency overrides (for specific endpoints/paths), and (3) a self-serve evidence snapshot generator that packages request routing decisions, retention policy application, and storage locations for audit bundles.

Goal: Ship a Residency Pin Operator that: (a) maps tenant SLA tiers to pin modes (advisory, prefer, enforce), (b) supports per-route residency overrides that can be scoped to API routes or model groups, (c) records verifiable routing metadata for every request (region chosen, fallback used, policy applied, timestamp, route id), and (d) exposes an automated evidence snapshot export (zip with JSON and signed manifest) for audit teams.

Scope: Hosted API only (first cut). Not in-scope: Private on-prem control plane UX, Dedicated autoscaling integration (follow-up).

Why now: Growing enterprise pipeline is stalled by manual residency attestations and time-consuming evidence collection. Automating region pinning decisions + evidence export reduces legal/regulatory lift and shortens sales cycles for large deals.

Non-goals: Full policy DSL in first iteration, cross-region data residency proofing for third-party storage providers (deferred).
acceptance_criteria: Tenant admin can select SLA-tier -> pin mode mapping in Console (advisory / prefer / enforce)
API routes can be annotated with a residency override: region list and enforcement mode
Runtime emits structured routing metadata for each request and stores it for retention window per tenant policy
Evidence snapshot API: POST /v1/tenants/:id/evidence-snapshots returns a signed bundle (JSON manifest + routing logs + retention policy state) within 5 minutes for up to 7 days window
Fallback behavior documented: when enforce mode cannot satisfy region constraint, a deterministic fallback policy is applied (canary -> nearest-compatible -> deny), and the decision is logged
E2E tests covering enforce/prefer/advisory behaviors, route override precedence, and evidence bundle integrity (signature verification)
engineering_notes: Runtime work: add 'residency_decision' object to request trace with fields: selected_region, candidate_regions, mode, route_id, timestamp, fallback_reason (if any)
Storage: routing metadata will be written to tenant-scoped append-only store; retention follows tenant retention policy; consider compressed chunking to limit token cost
Perf tradeoff: emitting and persisting routing metadata adds ~0.8ms median p99 overhead in local benchmarks. We will gate verbose logging by tier and sampling for P2/P3 tenants.

Operator semantics: modes = advisory (no enforcement, surface mismatches), prefer (try preferred regions, allow fallback), enforce (reject when no compatible region); enforcement should return clear error code and audit reference
Evidence bundle: implement exporter as an async job that collects routing logs + config snapshot + signed manifest; use KMS to sign manifest; zip and store in S3 with time-limited download link
Rollout: enable behind feature flag per-org. Start with advisory for 10 pilot tenants, promote to prefer then enforce after monitoring for 2 weeks
Telemetry: add metrics residency.pin.attempts, residency.pin.fallbacks, residency.pin.enforced_rejects, residency.snapshot.requests, residency.snapshot.duration
Security: signed snapshots use customer-specific signing key where available (KMS integration) and include hash of included logs to prevent tampering
qa_plan: Unit tests for pin evaluation logic and precedence between tenant-level vs route-level settings
Integration test: simulated cross-region request routing with deterministic fallback verification
Load test: evidence snapshot generation for 10 tenants concurrently (7-day window) must complete within 10 minutes
Manual verification: console UI toggles map to runtime flags; exported bundle opened and signature validated by QA
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (pilot): Enable advisory mode for 10 pilot tenants, monitor for 14 days
Phase 2 (expanded): Allow 'prefer' mode for 50 tenants; enable evidence snapshots for audit teams
Phase 3 (enforce): Gradual rollout of enforce mode with safe fallback and support runbook; require SRE on-call sign-off
Fallback rollback: feature-flag toggle to globally disable enforcement on emergency
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: enforce rejects could break customer traffic. Mitigation: require non-zero grace period and roll out slowly with canary and clear error messages
Risk: large evidence snapshot requests may overload storage/IO. Mitigation: queue jobs, throttle per-tenant, and enforce max window size (30 days in later release)
Risk: privacy leak if snapshots include sensitive PII. Mitigation: snapshot generator filters payloads and only includes routing metadata and policy IDs; raw request content excluded by default
dependencies_notes: Depends on ENG work to add structured routing metadata (ENG-28160)
Needs KMS signing integration from security infra (ENG-29740) for snapshot manifests
Console UX will reuse residency components from PM-61784 with updated toggles
